body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> LG presented its 23-inch full HD 1080p LCD monitor and digital TV combo 'M237WD' at the CES 2009.

Delivering a true multimedia experience, this model includes a widescreen 16:9 aspect ratio and built-in A/V inputs and allows consumers to plug in external devices, such as a Blu-ray disc player or a gaming console.
Its built-in ATSC tuner enables consumers to watch broadcast digital TV directly on the monitor and frees up valuable space at home or in the office.

M237WD features the unique f-ENGINE, a picture-enhancing chip that optimizes brightness and color independently of each other, reducing the washing out of colors normally found when brightness and contrast are adjusted. The chip makes these units perfect for gaming and graphic or video intensive projects.
